title: Old open shop orders drop off the gym's order list
what: The gym's order list only ever brings back the newest 300 orders, whatever their status. An order still waiting that is older than the newest 300 never reaches the desk, so it cannot be handed over or cancelled and its stock stays taken.
expected: Every open order (Ordered or Ready) is always on the list, however many orders are newer.
who: owners and front desk of busy shops
how_often: once a gym passes 300 orders with an old one still open
fix_line: Always return open orders, and cap only finished ones
